```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

# CSR round 12 (docs/specs/2026-10-19-csr-round12-platform-design.md §4.1, §4.2 and §6): live checks
# of the Istio ambient mesh on a running release.
#
#   M1  every running pod of the release namespace is enrolled (istio-cni set
#       ambient.istio.io/redirection=enabled on it);
#   M2  plaintext from a pod outside the mesh to a StarRocks BE port is refused, while a NetworkPolicy
#       admits that pod, and ztunnel logs the refusal;
#   M3  ztunnel reports mutual TLS for StarRocks FE -> BE and BE -> FE connections;
#   M4  the api is refused on a Jaeger port its rule does not list (16686) and reaches one it lists (4318);
#   M5  the edge gateway reaches the api: a gRPC call through the edge gets the api's own Bearer
#       challenge.
#
# M2 and M3 report SKIP when the release runs no StarRocks, and M4 when it runs no Jaeger (the laptop
# profile runs neither). Run it as the operators group: M4 execs into an api pod. It creates a
# namespace with one pod and one NetworkPolicy in the release namespace, all named
# mesh-check-<random>, and deletes them when it exits.
#
# Usage: mesh-check.sh [--release NAME] [--namespace NS]   (both default to iverson)
# Environment (the defaults fit the kind profile):
#   OPERATOR_AS      kubectl impersonation flags that add the operators group (default:
#                    --as=kubernetes-admin --as-group=kubeadm:cluster-admins --as-group=iverson-operators)
#   EDGE_GRPC        the api's gRPC host on the edge (default https://iverson.local:8443)
#   EDGE_ADDR        the address EDGE_GRPC's host resolves to (default 127.0.0.1)
#   EDGE_TLS_SECRET  the Secret holding the edge certificate, in the release namespace (default iverson-api-tls)
#   PROBE_IMAGE      the image of the pod outside the mesh (default docker.io/library/busybox:1.37.0)
# Exit status: 0 when no check fails, 1 when any fails, 2 on a usage error.

OPERATOR_AS=${OPERATOR_AS:---as=kubernetes-admin --as-group=kubeadm:cluster-admins --as-group=iverson-operators}
EDGE_GRPC=${EDGE_GRPC:-https://iverson.local:8443}
EDGE_ADDR=${EDGE_ADDR:-127.0.0.1}
EDGE_TLS_SECRET=${EDGE_TLS_SECRET:-iverson-api-tls}
PROBE_IMAGE=${PROBE_IMAGE:-docker.io/library/busybox:1.37.0}
RELEASE=iverson
NS=iverson
PASSED=0
FAILED=0
SKIPPED=0

usage() { echo "usage: ${0##*/} [--release NAME] [--namespace NS]" >&2; }

report() {  # <PASS|FAIL|SKIP> <id> <text>
  case "$1" in
    PASS) PASSED=$((PASSED + 1)) ;;
    SKIP) SKIPPED=$((SKIPPED + 1)) ;;
    *) FAILED=$((FAILED + 1)) ;;
  esac
  printf '%s %s %s\n' "$1" "$2" "$3"
}

result() {  # <id> <exit status of the check> <text>
  if [ "$2" -eq 0 ]; then report PASS "$1" "$3"; else report FAIL "$1" "$3"; fi
}

# Reads `kubectl get pods -o json` on stdin; prints the running pods that are not enrolled, one per
# line, after a first line with the number of running pods.
UNENROLLED_PY='
import json, sys
pods = [p for p in json.load(sys.stdin)["items"] if p["status"].get("phase") == "Running"]
print(len(pods))
for p in pods:
    if (p["metadata"].get("annotations") or {}).get("ambient.istio.io/redirection") != "enabled":
        print(p["metadata"]["name"])
'

# True when ztunnel recorded, as the destination, a mutual-TLS connection from workload <src> to
# workload <dst>.
mtls_seen() {  # <metrics file> <source workload> <destination workload>
  command grep -E '^istio_tcp_connections_opened_total\{' "$1" \
    | command grep -F 'reporter="destination"' \
    | command grep -F "source_workload=\"$2\"" \
    | command grep -F "destination_workload=\"$3\"" \
    | command grep -qF 'connection_security_policy="mutual_tls"'
}

# Bytes an api container receives for a plain HTTP request to <host>:<port>. ztunnel closes a
# connection its policy refuses, so a refused hop returns 0 bytes.
hop_bytes() {  # <api pod> <host> <port>
  kubectl "${OPS[@]}" -n "$NS" exec "$1" -c api -- bash -c \
    'exec 3<>"/dev/tcp/$1/$2" || exit 0; printf "GET / HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: probe\r\n\r\n" >&3; timeout 5 cat <&3' \
    _ "$2" "$3" 2>/dev/null | wc -c
}

# Forwards a free local port to <pod>:<port> in <namespace>; sets PF_PID and PF_PORT.
port_forward() {  # <namespace> <pod> <port>
  kubectl -n "$1" port-forward "$2" ":$3" > "$WORK/port-forward.log" 2>&1 &
  PF_PID=$!
  local _
  for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
    PF_PORT=$(sed -nE 's/^Forwarding from 127\.0\.0\.1:([0-9]+) .*/\1/p' "$WORK/port-forward.log" | head -n 1)
    [ -n "$PF_PORT" ] && return 0
    kill -0 "$PF_PID" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    sleep 1
  done
  return 1
}

cleanup() {
  [ -n "${PF_PID:-}" ] && kill "$PF_PID" 2>/dev/null
  kubectl -n "$NS" delete networkpolicy "$PROBE" --ignore-not-found --wait=false > /dev/null 2>&1
  kubectl delete namespace "$PROBE" --ignore-not-found --wait=false > /dev/null 2>&1
  rm -rf "$WORK"
}

if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" != "$0" ]]; then
  return 0
fi

while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --release) [ $# -ge 2 ] || { usage; exit 2; }; RELEASE=$2; shift 2 ;;
    --namespace) [ $# -ge 2 ] || { usage; exit 2; }; NS=$2; shift 2 ;;
    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    *) usage; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

read -r -a OPS <<< "$OPERATOR_AS"
PROBE="mesh-check-$(od -An -N3 -tx1 /dev/urandom | tr -d ' \n')"
WORK=$(mktemp -d)
PF_PID=""
trap cleanup EXIT

# M1: enrolment.
mapfile -t lines < <(kubectl -n "$NS" get pods -o json | python3 -c "$UNENROLLED_PY")
running=${lines[0]:-0}
unenrolled=("${lines[@]:1}")
[ "$running" -gt 0 ] && [ "${#unenrolled[@]}" -eq 0 ]
result M1 $? "$running running pods in $NS, not enrolled: ${unenrolled[*]:-none}"

be_ip=$(kubectl -n "$NS" get pods -l "app.starrocks.ownerreference/name=$RELEASE-starrocks-be" \
  -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.podIP}' 2>/dev/null)
fe_ip=$(kubectl -n "$NS" get pods -l "app.starrocks.ownerreference/name=$RELEASE-starrocks-fe" \
  -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.podIP}' 2>/dev/null)

# M2: plaintext from outside the mesh to the BE web port, with NetworkPolicy admitting it.
if [ -z "$be_ip" ]; then
  report SKIP M2 "no StarRocks BE pod in $NS"
else
  kubectl create namespace "$PROBE" > /dev/null
  kubectl -n "$NS" apply -f - > /dev/null <<EOF
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: $PROBE
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app.starrocks.ownerreference/name: $RELEASE-starrocks-be
  policyTypes: ["Ingress"]
  ingress:
    - from:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: $PROBE
      ports:
        - { protocol: TCP, port: 8040 }
EOF
  kubectl -n "$PROBE" run probe --image="$PROBE_IMAGE" --restart=Never -- sleep 600 > /dev/null
  kubectl -n "$PROBE" wait --for=condition=Ready pod/probe --timeout=180s > /dev/null
  probe_ip=$(kubectl -n "$PROBE" get pod probe -o jsonpath='{.status.podIP}')
  since=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
  kubectl -n "$PROBE" exec probe -- wget -q -O- -T 5 "http://$be_ip:8040/api/health" > /dev/null 2>&1
  answered=$?
  sleep 2
  rejections=$(kubectl -n istio-system logs -l app=ztunnel --since-time="$since" --tail=-1 2>/dev/null \
    | command grep -F "$probe_ip" | command grep -ciE 'rejection|denied')
  [ "$answered" -ne 0 ] && [ "${rejections:-0}" -gt 0 ]
  result M2 $? "plaintext $probe_ip -> BE $be_ip:8040: wget exit $answered, ztunnel refusals logged: ${rejections:-0}"
fi

# M3: FE <-> BE mutual TLS, as every ztunnel reports it.
if [ -z "$be_ip" ] || [ -z "$fe_ip" ]; then
  report SKIP M3 "no StarRocks FE and BE pods in $NS"
else
  : > "$WORK/metrics.txt"
  for zt in $(kubectl -n istio-system get pods -l app=ztunnel -o name); do
    if port_forward istio-system "$zt" 15020; then
      curl -s -m 15 "http://127.0.0.1:$PF_PORT/metrics" >> "$WORK/metrics.txt"
    fi
    kill "$PF_PID" 2>/dev/null
    PF_PID=""
  done
  fe="$RELEASE-starrocks-fe"
  be="$RELEASE-starrocks-be"
  mtls_seen "$WORK/metrics.txt" "$fe" "$be" && fe_be=yes || fe_be=no
  mtls_seen "$WORK/metrics.txt" "$be" "$fe" && be_fe=yes || be_fe=no
  [ "$fe_be" = yes ] && [ "$be_fe" = yes ]
  result M3 $? "ztunnel mutual_tls $fe -> $be: $fe_be, $be -> $fe: $be_fe"
fi

# M4: a port the api's Jaeger rule does not list.
api=$(kubectl -n "$NS" get pods -l "app=$RELEASE-api" --field-selector=status.phase=Running \
  -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}' 2>/dev/null)
if ! kubectl -n "$NS" get service "$RELEASE-jaeger" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  report SKIP M4 "no $RELEASE-jaeger Service in $NS"
else
  refused=$(hop_bytes "$api" "$RELEASE-jaeger" 16686)
  admitted=$(hop_bytes "$api" "$RELEASE-jaeger" 4318)
  [ "$refused" -eq 0 ] && [ "$admitted" -gt 0 ]
  result M4 $? "$api -> $RELEASE-jaeger: 16686 returned $refused bytes, 4318 returned $admitted bytes"
fi

# M5: the edge gateway reaches the api.
hostport=${EDGE_GRPC#https://}
host=${hostport%%:*}
port=${hostport##*:}
kubectl -n "$NS" get secret "$EDGE_TLS_SECRET" -o jsonpath='{.data.tls\.crt}' | base64 -d > "$WORK/edge.crt"
printf '\0\0\0\0\0' > "$WORK/empty.grpc"
headers=$(curl -sS -m 20 --http2 --cacert "$WORK/edge.crt" --resolve "$host:$port:$EDGE_ADDR" \
  -H 'content-type: application/grpc' -H 'te: trailers' --data-binary @"$WORK/empty.grpc" \
  -o /dev/null -D - "$EDGE_GRPC/iverson.ObjectSearchService/Search" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
status=$(printf '%s\n' "$headers" | sed -nE 's#^HTTP/[0-9.]+ ([0-9]+).*#\1#p' | head -n 1)
challenge=$(printf '%s\n' "$headers" | command grep -i '^www-authenticate: Bearer' | head -n 1)
[ "$status" = 401 ] && [ -n "$challenge" ]
result M5 $? "unauthenticated gRPC Search through $EDGE_GRPC: HTTP ${status:-none}, ${challenge:-no Bearer challenge}"

echo "${0##*/}: $PASSED passed, $FAILED failed, $SKIPPED skipped"
[ "$FAILED" -eq 0 ]
```

Create `Iverson.Server/deploy/scripts/admission-check.sh` with exactly this content:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

# CSR round 12 (docs/specs/2026-10-19-csr-round12-platform-design.md §3.1 and §6): live checks of the
# release's admission policy <release>-<namespace>-sensitive-identities, and of the two Authentik
# pins against a legacy service-account-token Secret's token.
#
# A non-operator here is a user with the namespace's built-in admin role plus the right to add
# ephemeral containers, so every refusal it meets comes from the admission policy, not from RBAC.
# The operators group is OPERATOR_AS. Each line names the request and its outcome: "admitted",
# "refused" (by the admission policy) or "error" (anything else).
#
#   N1-N8  a non-operator is refused: a token for <release>-api and for <release>-admin-automation,
#          exec into and port-forward to an api pod, a bare pod and a Job with a protected account,
#          an ephemeral container on an api pod, and an in-place image change of an api pod;
#   O1-O8  the operators group is admitted for each of those;
#   N9/O9  a non-operator is refused exec into the Postgres instance pod, the operators group admitted;
#   O10    the operators group is refused a protected-account pod named outside <release>-api-*;
#   L1/L2  a legacy service-account-token Secret's token for <release>-api is refused by the
#          orchestrator pin and one for <release>-admin-automation by the admin-automation pin;
#          a TokenRequest token of each account, the api's bound to a running api pod, is accepted.
#
# Bare pods, Jobs and image changes are server-side dry runs, which run admission and store nothing.
# Ephemeral containers cannot be dry-run: the operators' one goes on a throwaway pod named
# <release>-api-admission-check-<random> with the default service account. Tokens are discarded and
# never printed. It creates, and deletes when it exits, that pod, a Role and two RoleBindings named
# admission-check-<random>, and two legacy token Secrets of the same name prefix.
#
# Usage: admission-check.sh [--release NAME] [--namespace NS]   (both default to iverson)
# Environment (the defaults fit the kind profile):
#   OPERATOR_AS  kubectl impersonation flags that add the operators group (default:
#                --as=kubernetes-admin --as-group=kubeadm:cluster-admins --as-group=iverson-operators)
#   PROBE_IMAGE  the image of the probe's own containers (default docker.io/library/busybox:1.37.0)
# Exit status: 0 when every check passes, 1 when any fails, 2 on a usage error.

OPERATOR_AS=${OPERATOR_AS:---as=kubernetes-admin --as-group=kubeadm:cluster-admins --as-group=iverson-operators}
PROBE_IMAGE=${PROBE_IMAGE:-docker.io/library/busybox:1.37.0}
RELEASE=iverson
NS=iverson
PASSED=0
FAILED=0

usage() { echo "usage: ${0##*/} [--release NAME] [--namespace NS]" >&2; }

report() {  # <PASS|FAIL> <id> <text>
  if [ "$1" = PASS ]; then PASSED=$((PASSED + 1)); else FAILED=$((FAILED + 1)); fi
  printf '%s %s %s\n' "$1" "$2" "$3"
}

# admitted when the request succeeded, refused when the error names the release's admission policy,
# error otherwise.
classify() {  # <exit code> <output> <policy name>
  if [ "$1" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo admitted
  elif printf '%s' "$2" | command grep -qF -- "$3"; then
    echo refused
  else
    echo error
  fi
}

# Runs one request and reports it against the wanted outcome. A request's output is shown only when
# it failed, so an issued token is never printed.
expect() {  # <id> <text> <admitted|refused> <command...>
  local id=$1 text=$2 want=$3 out rc got
  shift 3
  out=$("$@" 2>&1)
  rc=$?
  got=$(classify "$rc" "$out" "$POLICY")
  if [ "$got" = "$want" ]; then
    report PASS "$id" "$text: $got"
  elif [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
    report FAIL "$id" "$text: $got, wanted $want"
  else
    report FAIL "$id" "$text: $got, wanted $want ($(printf '%s' "$out" | head -n 1 | cut -c1-200))"
  fi
}

# kubectl port-forward to <pod>:8081 and one HTTPS request through it; prints the classified outcome.
port_forward_outcome() {  # <impersonation flags...>
  local log="$WORK/port-forward-$RANDOM.log" pid lp="" code="000" _
  kubectl "$@" -n "$NS" port-forward "pod/$API_POD" :8081 > "$log" 2>&1 &
  pid=$!
  for _ in $(seq 1 15); do
    lp=$(sed -nE 's/^Forwarding from 127\.0\.0\.1:([0-9]+) .*/\1/p' "$log" | head -n 1)
    [ -n "$lp" ] && break
    kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || break
    sleep 1
  done
  [ -n "$lp" ] && code=$(curl -sk -o /dev/null -m 10 -w '%{http_code}' "https://127.0.0.1:$lp/health")
  sleep 1
  kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null
  wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null
  if command grep -qF -- "$POLICY" "$log"; then
    echo refused
  elif [ -n "$lp" ] && [ "$code" != 000 ]; then
    echo admitted
  else
    echo error
  fi
}

expect_port_forward() {  # <id> <text> <wanted> <impersonation flags...>
  local id=$1 text=$2 want=$3 got
  shift 3
  got=$(port_forward_outcome "$@")
  if [ "$got" = "$want" ]; then report PASS "$id" "$text: $got"; else report FAIL "$id" "$text: $got, wanted $want"; fi
}

# A token exchange at Authentik's token endpoint through the port-forward, with the assertion in
# PROBE_ASSERTION. Prints the HTTP status and the OAuth error code, never the issued token.
EXCHANGE_PY='
import json, os, sys, urllib.error, urllib.parse, urllib.request
base, client_id, scope = sys.argv[1:4]
body = urllib.parse.urlencode({
    "grant_type": "client_credentials",
    "client_id": client_id,
    "client_assertion_type": "urn:ietf:params:oauth:client-assertion-type:jwt-bearer",
    "client_assertion": os.environ["PROBE_ASSERTION"],
    "scope": scope,
}).encode()
request = urllib.request.Request(base + "/application/o/token/", data=body, method="POST",
                                 headers={"Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"})
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
        print(response.status, "-")
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    try:
        error = json.loads(e.read()).get("error", "?")
    except ValueError:
        error = "?"
    print(e.code, error)
'

exchange() {  # <assertion> <client id> <scope>
  PROBE_ASSERTION=$1 python3 -c "$EXCHANGE_PY" "http://127.0.0.1:$PF_PORT" "$2" "$3" 2>&1 | tail -n 1
}

expect_exchange() {  # <id> <text> <wanted "status error"> <assertion> <client id> <scope>
  local got
  got=$(exchange "$4" "$5" "$6")
  if [ "$got" = "$3" ]; then report PASS "$1" "$2: $got"; else report FAIL "$1" "$2: $got, wanted $3"; fi
}

legacy_token() {  # <secret name> <service account>: creates the Secret, prints its token once filled
  kubectl -n "$NS" apply -f - > /dev/null <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: $1
  annotations:
    kubernetes.io/service-account.name: $2
type: kubernetes.io/service-account-token
EOF
  local token="" _
  for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
    token=$(kubectl -n "$NS" get secret "$1" -o jsonpath='{.data.token}' 2>/dev/null | base64 -d)
    [ -n "$token" ] && break
    sleep 1
  done
  printf '%s' "$token"
}

start_port_forward() {  # forwards a free local port to svc/<release>-authentik:9000; sets PF_PID, PF_PORT
  kubectl "${OPS[@]}" -n "$NS" port-forward "svc/$RELEASE-authentik" :9000 > "$WORK/authentik-forward.log" 2>&1 &
  PF_PID=$!
  local _
  for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
    PF_PORT=$(sed -nE 's/^Forwarding from 127\.0\.0\.1:([0-9]+) .*/\1/p' "$WORK/authentik-forward.log" | head -n 1)
    [ -n "$PF_PORT" ] && return 0
    kill -0 "$PF_PID" 2>/dev/null || return 1
    sleep 1
  done
  return 1
}

cleanup() {
  [ -n "${PF_PID:-}" ] && kill "$PF_PID" 2>/dev/null
  kubectl -n "$NS" delete pod "$THROWAWAY" --ignore-not-found --wait=false > /dev/null 2>&1
  kubectl -n "$NS" delete secret "$PROBE-api" "$PROBE-automation" --ignore-not-found > /dev/null 2>&1
  kubectl -n "$NS" delete rolebinding "$PROBE-admin" "$PROBE-ephemeral" --ignore-not-found > /dev/null 2>&1
  kubectl -n "$NS" delete role "$PROBE-ephemeral" --ignore-not-found > /dev/null 2>&1
  rm -rf "$WORK"
}

if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" != "$0" ]]; then
  return 0
fi

while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --release) [ $# -ge 2 ] || { usage; exit 2; }; RELEASE=$2; shift 2 ;;
    --namespace) [ $# -ge 2 ] || { usage; exit 2; }; NS=$2; shift 2 ;;
    -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    *) usage; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

read -r -a OPS <<< "$OPERATOR_AS"
SUFFIX=$(od -An -N3 -tx1 /dev/urandom | tr -d ' \n')
PROBE="admission-check-$SUFFIX"
NONOP_USER="admission-check-nonoperator"
NON=(--as="$NONOP_USER")
POLICY="$RELEASE-$NS-sensitive-identities"
THROWAWAY="$RELEASE-api-admission-check-$SUFFIX"
API_SA="$RELEASE-api"
AUTOMATION_SA="$RELEASE-admin-automation"
WORK=$(mktemp -d)
PF_PID=""
PF_PORT=""
trap cleanup EXIT

kubectl -n "$NS" apply -f - > /dev/null <<EOF
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: $PROBE-admin
roleRef: { apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io, kind: ClusterRole, name: admin }
subjects: [{ apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io, kind: User, name: $NONOP_USER }]
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: $PROBE-ephemeral
rules:
  - { apiGroups: [""], resources: ["pods/ephemeralcontainers"], verbs: ["get", "patch", "update"] }
  - { apiGroups: [""], resources: ["serviceaccounts/token"], verbs: ["create"] }
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: $PROBE-ephemeral
roleRef: { apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io, kind: Role, name: $PROBE-ephemeral }
subjects: [{ apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io, kind: User, name: $NONOP_USER }]
EOF

API_POD=$(kubectl -n "$NS" get pods -l "app=$RELEASE-api" --field-selector=status.phase=Running \
  -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
API_UID=$(kubectl -n "$NS" get pod "$API_POD" -o jsonpath='{.metadata.uid}')
POSTGRES_POD="$RELEASE-postgres-1"
cat > "$WORK/job.yaml" <<EOF
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: $PROBE
  namespace: $NS
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: $AUTOMATION_SA
      restartPolicy: Never
      containers:
        - { name: probe, image: "$PROBE_IMAGE", command: ["true"] }
EOF
bare() {  # <impersonation flags...> -- <pod name> <service account>
  local flags=()
  while [ "$1" != -- ]; do flags+=("$1"); shift; done
  kubectl "${flags[@]}" -n "$NS" run "$2" --image="$PROBE_IMAGE" --restart=Never --dry-run=server \
    --overrides="{\"spec\":{\"serviceAccountName\":\"$3\"}}" -- true
}

# N1-N8: the non-operator.
expect N1 "non-operator: token for $API_SA" refused \
  kubectl "${NON[@]}" -n "$NS" create token "$API_SA" --audience admission-check --duration 10m
expect N2 "non-operator: token for $AUTOMATION_SA" refused \
  kubectl "${NON[@]}" -n "$NS" create token "$AUTOMATION_SA" --audience admission-check --duration 10m
expect N3 "non-operator: exec into $API_POD" refused \
  kubectl "${NON[@]}" -n "$NS" exec "$API_POD" -c api -- true
expect_port_forward N4 "non-operator: port-forward to $API_POD" refused "${NON[@]}"
expect N5 "non-operator: bare pod $RELEASE-api-$SUFFIX with $API_SA (dry run)" refused \
  bare "${NON[@]}" -- "$RELEASE-api-$SUFFIX" "$API_SA"
expect N6 "non-operator: Job with $AUTOMATION_SA (dry run)" refused \
  kubectl "${NON[@]}" create --dry-run=server -f "$WORK/job.yaml"
expect N7 "non-operator: ephemeral container on $API_POD" refused \
  kubectl "${NON[@]}" -n "$NS" debug "$API_POD" --image="$PROBE_IMAGE" --profile=baseline -c "$PROBE" -- true
expect N8 "non-operator: image change of $API_POD (dry run)" refused \
  kubectl "${NON[@]}" -n "$NS" set image "pod/$API_POD" "api=$PROBE_IMAGE" --dry-run=server
expect N9 "non-operator: exec into $POSTGRES_POD" refused \
  kubectl "${NON[@]}" -n "$NS" exec "$POSTGRES_POD" -c postgres -- true

# O1-O10: the operators group.
expect O1 "operators: token for $API_SA" admitted \
  kubectl "${OPS[@]}" -n "$NS" create token "$API_SA" --audience admission-check --duration 10m
expect O2 "operators: token for $AUTOMATION_SA" admitted \
  kubectl "${OPS[@]}" -n "$NS" create token "$AUTOMATION_SA" --audience admission-check --duration 10m
expect O3 "operators: exec into $API_POD" admitted \
  kubectl "${OPS[@]}" -n "$NS" exec "$API_POD" -c api -- true
expect_port_forward O4 "operators: port-forward to $API_POD" admitted "${OPS[@]}"
expect O5 "operators: bare pod $RELEASE-api-$SUFFIX with $API_SA (dry run)" admitted \
  bare "${OPS[@]}" -- "$RELEASE-api-$SUFFIX" "$API_SA"
expect O6 "operators: Job with $AUTOMATION_SA (dry run)" admitted \
  kubectl "${OPS[@]}" create --dry-run=server -f "$WORK/job.yaml"
kubectl "${OPS[@]}" -n "$NS" run "$THROWAWAY" --image="$PROBE_IMAGE" --restart=Never -- sleep 600 > /dev/null
kubectl -n "$NS" wait --for=condition=Ready "pod/$THROWAWAY" --timeout=180s > /dev/null
expect O7 "operators: ephemeral container on $THROWAWAY" admitted \
  kubectl "${OPS[@]}" -n "$NS" debug "$THROWAWAY" --image="$PROBE_IMAGE" --profile=baseline -c "$PROBE" -- true
expect O8 "operators: image change of $API_POD (dry run)" admitted \
  kubectl "${OPS[@]}" -n "$NS" set image "pod/$API_POD" "api=$PROBE_IMAGE" --dry-run=server
expect O9 "operators: exec into $POSTGRES_POD" admitted \
  kubectl "${OPS[@]}" -n "$NS" exec "$POSTGRES_POD" -c postgres -- true
expect O10 "operators: bare pod $PROBE with $API_SA (dry run)" refused \
  bare "${OPS[@]}" -- "$PROBE" "$API_SA"

# L1, L2: legacy service-account-token Secrets against the two pins, each beside an accepted control.
if start_port_forward; then
  legacy=$(legacy_token "$PROBE-api" "$API_SA")
  control=$(kubectl "${OPS[@]}" -n "$NS" create token "$API_SA" --audience iverson-authentik-orchestrator \
    --duration 10m --bound-object-kind Pod --bound-object-name "$API_POD" --bound-object-uid "$API_UID")
  expect_exchange L1 "orchestrator pin, legacy Secret token for $API_SA" "400 invalid_grant" \
    "$legacy" iverson-admin-orchestrator goauthentik.io/api
  expect_exchange L1c "orchestrator pin, TokenRequest token bound to $API_POD" "200 -" \
    "$control" iverson-admin-orchestrator goauthentik.io/api
  automation_client=$(kubectl -n "$NS" get secret "$RELEASE-authentik-admin-automation-client" \
    -o jsonpath='{.data.client-id}' | base64 -d)
  legacy=$(legacy_token "$PROBE-automation" "$AUTOMATION_SA")
  control=$(kubectl "${OPS[@]}" -n "$NS" create token "$AUTOMATION_SA" \
    --audience iverson-authentik-admin-automation --duration 10m)
  expect_exchange L2 "admin-automation pin, legacy Secret token for $AUTOMATION_SA" "400 invalid_grant" \
    "$legacy" "$automation_client" "admin schema_admin tenant_id_admin"
  expect_exchange L2c "admin-automation pin, TokenRequest token for $AUTOMATION_SA" "200 -" \
    "$control" "$automation_client" "admin schema_admin tenant_id_admin"
  unset legacy control
else
  report FAIL L1 "cannot port-forward to svc/$RELEASE-authentik as the operators group"
fi

echo "${0##*/}: $PASSED passed, $FAILED failed"
[ "$FAILED" -eq 0 ]
```

### Task 26: Static checks on every overlay, the operator-namespace chart and Terraform

**Spec:** §6 "Chart and Terraform" (every render assertion), plus §6 "Operator list"'s "the fallback is absent from every Helm render". Verified assumptions 39, 43, 50, 63, 66, 79.

**Files:** none in the repo, and no commit. Scratch only, under `$SCR`:
- `$SCR/check_t26.py`: the per-overlay render assertions, one section each: `vap` (the policy and binding names and rules), `kafka` (`networkPolicyPeers`), `hbone` (15008 beside every listed port), `gateway-kind` (the kind routes), `gateway-gcp` (the GKE Gateway, routes, `BackendTLSPolicy`, `GCPBackendPolicy`, `HealthCheckPolicy`), `pdb`/`pdb-profile` (the Authentik PDB and anti-affinity only when replicas > 1), `postgres-self` (Postgres admits its own instances in both layers), `mirror` (an `AuthorizationPolicy` per workload whose principals and ports match its NetworkPolicy ingress, `ipBlocks` only on cloud PERMISSIVE ports), `starrocks-sa` (the FE and BE service accounts) and `fallback` (`Authorization:OperatorGroupFallback` in no render);
- `$SCR/check_t26_opns.py`: the operator-namespace policies (§3.4 table, 15008, the CNPG `PeerAuthentication`);
- `$SCR/check_t26_tf.py`: AKS `key_management_service`, the dedicated KMS vault and key with exactly their one tfsec ignore each, and tfsec's counts;
- `$SCR/t26_mut.py`: one named mutation of a render;
- the drivers `$SCR/t26_render.sh`, `$SCR/t26_ci.sh`, `$SCR/t26_neg.sh` (renders that must fail, and the fallback and replica toggles), `$SCR/t26_opns.sh`, `$SCR/t26_tf.sh` and `$SCR/t26_mutate.sh`.

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes every chart and Terraform task. Names this task assumes, which the assembler must reconcile with the tasks that create them:
  - Task 11: value `admission.operatorGroups` (top-level in the umbrella chart), `["iverson-operators"]` on local and laptop; one `ValidatingAdmissionPolicy` and one `ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding`, both `iverson-iverson-sensitive-identities`, the binding's `matchResources.namespaceSelector` selecting `kubernetes.io/metadata.name: iverson`; the rules' CEL names the protected accounts, the four pod-name prefixes, `system:nodes`, the seven controller usernames and the operators group(s) as literal strings.
  - Task 8: value `authentik.serviceAccountIssuer`; Task 4: value `global.operatorSubjects`; Task 14: values `networkPolicy.nodeSubnetFallback` and the existing `networkPolicy.keepFallbacks`.
  - Task 7: value `authentik.server.replicas`; the PDB selects `app: iverson-authentik-server`; anti-affinity is `preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution` on `kubernetes.io/hostname`.
  - Task 12: the Kafka CR's `tls` listener `networkPolicyPeers` are exactly the two pod selectors `app: iverson-api` and `app: iverson-worker`.
  - Task 18: each `AuthorizationPolicy` selects with the `matchLabels` of its NetworkPolicy's `podSelector`, or, for a selector with an `In` expression (StarRocks FE/BE), one policy per value; ports are strings; cross-namespace principals are `cnpg-system/sa/cnpg-cloudnative-pg`, `kafka/sa/strimzi-cluster-operator` and `iverson-edge/sa/edge-istio` (a Gateway named `edge`, Task 20); Strimzi pods' principals are `<kafka>-kafka` and, when the Kafka CR has an `entityOperator`, `<kafka>-entity-operator`; StarRocks FE/BE service accounts `iverson-starrocks-fe`/`-be` rendered as `ServiceAccount` objects.
  - Tasks 20 and 21: `global.gateway.class` set on local, laptop and gcp so that those renders carry no `Ingress`; the kind routes reach `iverson-api:8080` (GRPCRoute), `iverson-api:8081`, `iverson-authentik:9080` and `iverson-admin-ui`; the GKE `GCPBackendPolicy` carries `authentik.ingress.securityPolicy` (the CI override's `iverson-authentik-login`).
  - Task 14: the operator-namespace chart at `Iverson.Server/deploy/terraform/modules/operators/charts/operator-namespace-policies`, with its own `values-kind.yaml`, values `kind` (bool: adds `tigera-operator` and `iverson-edge`) and `apiServerCidrs` (release `iverson` in `iverson` by default), and every object carrying `metadata.namespace`; Task 18 adds the CNPG `PeerAuthentication` to it (STRICT, 9443 PERMISSIVE only with `cnpgWebhookPermissive: true`, which `modules/operators` sets on the clouds and kind leaves unset); the KMS vault, key and control-plane access policy in `modules/cluster-azure/main.tf`, each ignore on its own comment line directly above its resource (the module's style, `cluster-azure/main.tf:44`).

- Produces for Task 27: the `final-*` renders and kube-score sets under `$SCR/t26/`, and `$SCR/t26-main/` (main's tree, from `git archive`).

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the checks**

Create the scratch files. Each heredoc delimiter is unique and appears in no content.

```bash
source /tmp/claude-1000/-home-ben-repositories-Iverson/a8dc481d-50d9-445a-974d-18c6594e3306/scratchpad/csr12p-sdd/env.sh
mkdir -p $SCR/t26
cat > $SCR/check_t26.py <<'T26CHECK'
"""CSR round 12 Platform §6 render assertions for one overlay.

python3 check_t26.py <overlay> <chart dir> [section ...] < render.yaml

Sections (default: all that apply to the overlay): vap, kafka, hbone, gateway-kind, gateway-gcp,
pdb, pdb-profile, postgres-self, mirror, starrocks-sa, fallback. Prints "[<overlay>] PASS" or
"[<overlay>] FAIL" followed by one line per failed assertion; exits 1 on any failure.
"""
import json
import sys

import yaml

OVERLAY, CHART = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
REL = NS = "iverson"
CLOUD = OVERLAY in ("values-aws", "values-azure", "values-gcp")
GCP = OVERLAY == "values-gcp"
DOCS = [d for d in yaml.safe_load_all(sys.stdin) if d]
FAILS = []


def check(cond, msg):
    if not cond:
        FAILS.append(msg)


def of(kind):
    return [d for d in DOCS if d.get("kind") == kind]


def one(kind, name):
    return next((d for d in of(kind) if d["metadata"]["name"] == name), None)


def deep_merge(base, over):
    out = dict(base)
    for k, v in (over or {}).items():
        out[k] = deep_merge(out[k], v) if isinstance(v, dict) and isinstance(out.get(k), dict) else v
    return out


def values():
    """values.yaml, the overlay and its CI override, merged as Helm merges -f files."""
    merged = yaml.safe_load(open(f"{CHART}/values.yaml")) or {}
    for f in (f"{CHART}/{OVERLAY}.yaml", f"{CHART}/{OVERLAY}.ci-override.yaml"):
        try:
            merged = deep_merge(merged, yaml.safe_load(open(f)) or {})
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass
    return merged


VALUES = values()


def selects_only(selector, key, value):
    """A label selector that selects exactly key=value (matchLabels or a one-value In expression)."""
    selector = selector or {}
    if selector.get("matchLabels") == {key: value} and not selector.get("matchExpressions"):
        return True
    return not selector.get("matchLabels") and selector.get("matchExpressions") == [
        {"key": key, "operator": "In", "values": [value]}]


# ---- vap: the admission policy and its binding (§3.1) ----------------------------------------------
def section_vap():
    name = f"{REL}-{NS}-sensitive-identities"
    vap, binding = one("ValidatingAdmissionPolicy", name), one("ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding", name)
    check(vap is not None, f"ValidatingAdmissionPolicy {name} missing")
    check(binding is not None, f"ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding {name} missing")
    counts = (len(of("ValidatingAdmissionPolicy")), len(of("ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding")))
    check(counts == (1, 1), f"the chart renders {counts[0]} ValidatingAdmissionPolicies and {counts[1]} bindings, not one each")
    if not (vap and binding):
        return
    spec, bspec = vap["spec"], binding["spec"]
    check(spec.get("failurePolicy") == "Fail", f"failurePolicy is {spec.get('failurePolicy')}, not Fail")
    check(bspec.get("policyName") == name, f"binding policyName is {bspec.get('policyName')}")
    check(bspec.get("validationActions") == ["Deny"], f"binding validationActions is {bspec.get('validationActions')}")
    check(selects_only((bspec.get("matchResources") or {}).get("namespaceSelector"),
                       "kubernetes.io/metadata.name", NS),
          "the binding's namespaceSelector does not select exactly the release namespace")
    covered = set()
    for rule in (spec.get("matchConstraints") or {}).get("resourceRules") or []:
        for g in rule.get("apiGroups", []):
            for r in rule.get("resources", []):
                for op in rule.get("operations", []):
                    covered.add((g, r, op))
    def has(g, r, op):
        return any(cg in (g, "*") and cr in (r, "*") and cop in (op, "*") for cg, cr, cop in covered)
    wanted = [("", "serviceaccounts/token", "CREATE"), ("", "pods/exec", "CONNECT"), ("", "pods/attach", "CONNECT"),
              ("", "pods/portforward", "CONNECT"), ("", "pods", "CREATE"), ("", "pods", "UPDATE"),
              ("", "pods/ephemeralcontainers", "UPDATE")]
    for r in ("deployments", "replicasets", "statefulsets", "daemonsets"):
        wanted += [("apps", r, "CREATE"), ("apps", r, "UPDATE")]
    for r in ("jobs", "cronjobs"):
        wanted += [("batch", r, "CREATE"), ("batch", r, "UPDATE")]
    for g, r, op in wanted:
        check(has(g, r, op), f"the policy does not match {op} on {g or 'core'}/{r}")
    text = yaml.safe_dump(vap) + yaml.safe_dump(binding)
    for s in (f"{REL}-api", f"{REL}-admin-automation", f"{REL}-api-", f"{REL}-worker-", f"{REL}-authentik-",
              f"{REL}-postgres-", "system:nodes", "oldObject", "initContainers"):
        check(s in text, f"the policy never names {s!r}")
    for c in ("replicaset-controller", "statefulset-controller", "job-controller", "daemon-set-controller",
              "deployment-controller", "cronjob-controller", "generic-garbage-collector"):
        check(f"system:serviceaccount:kube-system:{c}" in text, f"the policy does not admit {c}")
    groups = (VALUES.get("admission") or {}).get("operatorGroups") or []
    check(bool(groups), "admission.operatorGroups is empty in the merged values")
    if not CLOUD:
        check(groups == ["iverson-operators"], f"admission.operatorGroups on {OVERLAY} is {groups}")
    for g in groups:
        check(str(g) in text, f"the policy does not name operators group {g!r}")


# ---- kafka: the tls listener's peers (§3.2) -----------------------------------------------------------
def section_kafka():
    kafka = one("Kafka", f"{REL}-kafka")
    check(kafka is not None, f"Kafka {REL}-kafka missing")
    if not kafka:
        return
    tls = next((l for l in kafka["spec"]["kafka"].get("listeners", []) if l.get("name") == "tls"), None)
    check(tls is not None, "Kafka has no tls listener")
    want = sorted(json.dumps({"podSelector": {"matchLabels": {"app": f"{REL}-{w}"}}}, sort_keys=True)
                  for w in ("api", "worker"))
    got = sorted(json.dumps(p, sort_keys=True) for p in (tls or {}).get("networkPolicyPeers") or [])
    check(got == want, f"Kafka tls listener networkPolicyPeers is {got}, not the api and worker pod selectors")


# ---- hbone: 15008 beside every listed port (§4.2) -----------------------------------------------------
def section_hbone():
    for np in of("NetworkPolicy"):
        for direction in ("ingress", "egress"):
            for i, rule in enumerate(np["spec"].get(direction) or []):
                ports = rule.get("ports") or []
                numbers = {p.get("port") for p in ports}
                if not ports:
                    continue
                check(any(p.get("port") == 15008 and p.get("protocol", "TCP") == "TCP" for p in ports),
                      f"NetworkPolicy {np['metadata']['name']} {direction}[{i}] lists ports "
                      f"{sorted(numbers, key=str)} without 15008")


# ---- gateway-kind: the Istio gateway routes on local and laptop (§4.5) -------------------------------
SIX = {f"iverson.{s}" for s in ("ObjectMappingService", "ObjectPersistenceService", "ObjectRetrievalService",
                                 "ObjectSearchService", "TenantLifecycleGrpcService", "TenantAdminGrpcService")}


def backends(route):
    return {(b.get("name"), b.get("port")) for r in route["spec"].get("rules", []) for b in r.get("backendRefs", [])}


def filters(route):
    return [f for r in route["spec"].get("rules", []) for f in r.get("filters", []) or []]


def section_gateway_kind():
    check(not of("Ingress"), f"Ingress renders on {OVERLAY}: {[d['metadata']['name'] for d in of('Ingress')]}")
    check(any(any(t.get("kind") == "Secret" and t.get("name") == "iverson-api-tls" for t in g["spec"].get("to", []))
              for g in of("ReferenceGrant")), "no ReferenceGrant for Secret iverson-api-tls")
    grpc = of("GRPCRoute")
    services = {m.get("method", {}).get("service") for r in grpc for rule in r["spec"].get("rules", [])
                for m in rule.get("matches", [])}
    check(services == SIX, f"GRPCRoute services are {sorted(s for s in services if s)}, not the six")
    check(all(backends(r) == {(f"{REL}-api", 8080)} for r in grpc) and grpc, "GRPCRoute backend is not api:8080")
    http = of("HTTPRoute")
    authentik = [r for r in http if (f"{REL}-authentik", 9080) in backends(r)]
    check(len(authentik) == 1, f"{len(authentik)} HTTPRoutes reach {REL}-authentik:9080")
    admin_api = [r for r in http if (f"{REL}-api", 8081) in backends(r)]
    if (VALUES.get("api") or {}).get("adminConsoleEnabled"):
        check(len(admin_api) == 1, f"{len(admin_api)} HTTPRoutes reach {REL}-api:8081 with the admin console on")
        paths = {m.get("path", {}).get("value") for r in admin_api for rule in r["spec"].get("rules", [])
                 for m in rule.get("matches", [])}
        check(paths == {"/admin", "/health", "/v1/traces"}, f"admin-api HTTPRoute paths are {sorted(p for p in paths if p)}")
    else:
        check(not admin_api, "an admin-api HTTPRoute renders with the admin console off")
    admin_ui = [r for r in http if any(b[0] == f"{REL}-admin-ui" for b in backends(r))]
    if (VALUES.get("adminUi") or {}).get("enabled", True):
        check(len(admin_ui) == 1, f"{len(admin_ui)} HTTPRoutes reach {REL}-admin-ui")
        check(any(f.get("type") == "URLRewrite" for r in admin_ui for f in filters(r)), "admin-ui HTTPRoute has no URLRewrite")
    else:
        check(not admin_ui, "an admin-ui HTTPRoute renders with admin-ui off")
    headers = {h.get("name", "").lower() for r in http + grpc for f in filters(r) if f.get("type") == "ResponseHeaderModifier"
               for h in (f.get("responseHeaderModifier") or {}).get("set", []) + (f.get("responseHeaderModifier") or {}).get("add", [])}
    for h in ("x-frame-options", "x-content-type-options", "referrer-policy"):
        check(h in headers, f"no ResponseHeaderModifier sets {h}")
    tls_targets = {t.get("name") for p in of("BackendTLSPolicy") for t in p["spec"].get("targetRefs", [])}
    for svc in (f"{REL}-api", f"{REL}-authentik"):
        check(svc in tls_targets, f"no BackendTLSPolicy targets Service {svc}")


# ---- gateway-gcp: the GKE Gateway (§4.5) ---------------------------------------------------------------
def find(obj, key):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        for k, v in obj.items():
            if k == key:
                yield v
            yield from find(v, key)
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for v in obj:
            yield from find(v, key)


def section_gateway_gcp():
    for kind in ("Ingress", "BackendConfig", "GRPCRoute"):
        check(not of(kind), f"{kind} renders on values-gcp")
    gws = of("Gateway")
    check(len(gws) == 1, f"{len(gws)} Gateways render on values-gcp")
    if gws:
        spec = gws[0]["spec"]
        check(spec.get("gatewayClassName") == "gke-l7-global-external-managed", f"gatewayClassName is {spec.get('gatewayClassName')}")
        listeners = spec.get("listeners", [])
        check(listeners and all(l.get("protocol") == "HTTPS" and l.get("port") == 443 and (l.get("tls") or {}).get("certificateRefs")
                                for l in listeners), "a Gateway listener is not HTTPS 443 with certificateRefs")
        check(not any(l.get("port") == 80 or l.get("protocol") == "HTTP" for l in listeners), "the Gateway has a port 80 or HTTP listener")
        check(any(a.get("type") == "NamedAddress" and a.get("value") for a in spec.get("addresses", [])), "the Gateway has no NamedAddress")
    routed = {b for r in of("HTTPRoute") for b in backends(r)}
    for b in ((f"{REL}-api", 8080), (f"{REL}-api", 8081), (f"{REL}-authentik", 9080)):
        check(b in routed, f"no HTTPRoute reaches {b[0]}:{b[1]}")
    check(any(f.get("type") == "URLRewrite" for r in of("HTTPRoute") for f in filters(r)
              if any(x[0] == f"{REL}-admin-ui" for x in backends(r))), "admin-ui HTTPRoute has no URLRewrite")
    api_svc, ak_svc = one("Service", f"{REL}-api"), one("Service", f"{REL}-authentik")
    def proto(svc, port):
        return next((p.get("appProtocol") for p in (svc or {}).get("spec", {}).get("ports", []) if p.get("port") == port), None)
    check(proto(api_svc, 8080) == "HTTP2", f"api Service 8080 appProtocol is {proto(api_svc, 8080)}")
    check(proto(api_svc, 8081) == "HTTPS", f"api Service 8081 appProtocol is {proto(api_svc, 8081)}")
    check(proto(ak_svc, 9080) == "HTTPS", f"authentik Service 9080 appProtocol is {proto(ak_svc, 9080)}")
    check(not any("cloud.google.com/app-protocols" in (s["metadata"].get("annotations") or {}) for s in of("Service")),
          "a Service still carries cloud.google.com/app-protocols")
    configmaps = {c["metadata"]["name"]: c for c in of("ConfigMap")}
    tls = {t.get("name"): p for p in of("BackendTLSPolicy") for t in p["spec"].get("targetRefs", [])}
    for svc in (f"{REL}-api", f"{REL}-authentik"):
        p = tls.get(svc)
        check(p is not None, f"no BackendTLSPolicy targets Service {svc}")
        if p:
            v = p["spec"].get("validation", {})
            check(bool(v.get("hostname")), f"BackendTLSPolicy for {svc} has no hostname")
            refs = [r.get("name") for r in v.get("caCertificateRefs", [])]
            check(refs and all("ca.crt" in (configmaps.get(r) or {}).get("data", {}) for r in refs),
                  f"BackendTLSPolicy for {svc} names no ConfigMap with ca.crt")
    gbp = [p for p in of("GCPBackendPolicy") if f"{REL}-authentik" in set(find(p["spec"], "name"))]
    want_policy = ((VALUES.get("authentik") or {}).get("ingress") or {}).get("securityPolicy")
    check(len(gbp) == 1, f"{len(gbp)} GCPBackendPolicies target {REL}-authentik")
    if gbp:
        check(want_policy and want_policy in set(find(gbp[0]["spec"], "securityPolicy")),
              f"GCPBackendPolicy securityPolicy is not {want_policy!r}")
        check(any(True for _ in find(gbp[0]["spec"], "timeoutSec")), "GCPBackendPolicy sets no timeoutSec")
    hc = {}
    for p in of("HealthCheckPolicy"):
        for name in find(p["spec"].get("targetRef", {}), "name"):
            hc[name] = p["spec"]
    ak, api = hc.get(f"{REL}-authentik"), hc.get(f"{REL}-api")
    check(ak is not None and "HTTPS" in set(find(ak, "type")) and "/-/health/live/" in set(find(ak, "requestPath"))
          and 9080 in set(find(ak, "port")), "no HTTPS /-/health/live/ 9080 HealthCheckPolicy on Authentik")
    check(api is not None and "HTTPS" in set(find(api, "type")) and 8081 in set(find(api, "port")),
          "no HTTPS 8081 HealthCheckPolicy on the api")


# ---- pdb: Authentik server PDB and anti-affinity only when replicas > 1 (§2.1) -----------------------
def section_pdb(profile):
    dep = one("Deployment", f"{REL}-authentik-server")
    check(dep is not None, f"Deployment {REL}-authentik-server missing")
    if not dep:
        return
    replicas = dep["spec"].get("replicas", 1)
    if profile:
        check(replicas == (2 if CLOUD else 1), f"authentik server replicas on {OVERLAY} is {replicas}")
    pdbs = [p for p in of("PodDisruptionBudget")
            if (p["spec"].get("selector") or {}).get("matchLabels") == {"app": f"{REL}-authentik-server"}]
    anti = ((dep["spec"]["template"]["spec"].get("affinity") or {}).get("podAntiAffinity") or {})
    preferred = anti.get("preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution") or []
    if replicas > 1:
        check(len(pdbs) == 1 and pdbs[0]["spec"].get("maxUnavailable") == 1,
              f"replicas {replicas}: no Authentik server PodDisruptionBudget with maxUnavailable 1")
        check(any(t.get("podAffinityTerm", {}).get("topologyKey") == "kubernetes.io/hostname" for t in preferred)
              and not anti.get("requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution"),
              f"replicas {replicas}: no preferred host anti-affinity on the Authentik server")
    else:
        check(not pdbs, "replicas 1: an Authentik server PodDisruptionBudget renders")
        check(not anti, "replicas 1: the Authentik server carries podAntiAffinity")


# ---- postgres-self: the instances admit each other (§4.3 #4) -----------------------------------------
PG = {"cnpg.io/cluster": f"{REL}-postgres"}


def section_postgres_self():
    nps = [n for n in of("NetworkPolicy") if (n["spec"].get("podSelector") or {}).get("matchLabels") == PG
           and "Ingress" in n["spec"].get("policyTypes", [])]
    check(any(not r.get("ports") and {"podSelector": {"matchLabels": PG}} in (r.get("from") or [])
              for n in nps for r in n["spec"].get("ingress") or []),
          "no port-less Postgres ingress rule from the Postgres instances")
    aps = [a for a in of("AuthorizationPolicy") if (a["spec"].get("selector") or {}).get("matchLabels") == PG]
    principal = f"cluster.local/ns/{NS}/sa/{REL}-postgres"
    check(any(not r.get("to") and any(principal in (f.get("source") or {}).get("principals", []) for f in r.get("from", []))
              for a in aps for r in a["spec"].get("rules", [])),
          f"no Postgres AuthorizationPolicy rule admits {principal} on all ports")


# ---- mirror: an AuthorizationPolicy per workload that mirrors its NetworkPolicy ingress (§4.2) -------
PROBE_SOURCE = "169.254.7.127/32"
EXTERNAL = {  # namespace of a cross-namespace NetworkPolicy peer -> the principal it stands for
    "cnpg-system": "cluster.local/ns/cnpg-system/sa/cnpg-cloudnative-pg",
    "kafka": "cluster.local/ns/kafka/sa/strimzi-cluster-operator",
    "iverson-edge": "cluster.local/ns/iverson-edge/sa/edge-istio",
}


def workload_accounts():
    """(pod labels, service account) for every pod the release creates, including the operators' pods."""
    out = []
    for kind in ("Deployment", "StatefulSet", "DaemonSet"):
        for d in of(kind):
            t = d["spec"]["template"]
            out.append((t.get("metadata", {}).get("labels") or {}, t["spec"].get("serviceAccountName", "default")))
    for j in of("Job"):
        out.append(({"job-name": j["metadata"]["name"]}, j["spec"]["template"]["spec"].get("serviceAccountName", "default")))
    for c in of("Cluster"):
        out.append(({"cnpg.io/cluster": c["metadata"]["name"]}, c["metadata"]["name"]))
    for k in of("Kafka"):
        name = k["metadata"]["name"]
        out.append(({"strimzi.io/cluster": name}, f"{name}-kafka"))
        if k["spec"].get("entityOperator"):
            out.append(({"strimzi.io/cluster": name}, f"{name}-entity-operator"))
    for s in of("StarRocksCluster"):
        name = s["metadata"]["name"]
        for part, key in (("fe", "starRocksFeSpec"), ("be", "starRocksBeSpec")):
            if key in s["spec"]:
                out.append(({"app.starrocks.ownerreference/name": f"{name}-{part}"},
                            s["spec"][key].get("serviceAccount", "default")))
    return out


ACCOUNTS = None


def label_sets(selector):
    """The concrete label sets a selector stands for: matchLabels, or one set per In value."""
    selector = selector or {}
    base = dict(selector.get("matchLabels") or {})
    sets = [base]
    for e in selector.get("matchExpressions") or []:
        if e.get("operator") != "In":
            return None
        sets = [dict(s, **{e["key"]: v}) for s in sets for v in e["values"]]
    return sets


def rendered(labels):
    """True when some pod the release creates carries all of these labels."""
    return any(all(pod_labels.get(k) == v for k, v in labels.items()) for pod_labels, _ in ACCOUNTS)


def principals_for(peer):
    """(required, optional) principals for one NetworkPolicy peer, or None for an ipBlock peer. A peer that selects
    no pod the release renders (a disabled component) is optional: the policy may or may not name it."""
    if "ipBlock" in peer:
        return None
    ns_sel = peer.get("namespaceSelector")
    if ns_sel is not None:
        ns = (ns_sel.get("matchLabels") or {}).get("kubernetes.io/metadata.name")
        if ns != NS:
            return ({EXTERNAL[ns]} if ns in EXTERNAL else {f"unknown-namespace:{ns}"}), set()
    required, optional = set(), set()
    for labels in label_sets(peer.get("podSelector")) or []:
        hits = {sa for pod_labels, sa in ACCOUNTS if all(pod_labels.get(k) == v for k, v in labels.items())}
        if hits:
            required |= hits
        elif "app" in labels:
            optional.add(labels["app"])
        else:
            optional.add(f"unmatched:{json.dumps(labels, sort_keys=True)}")
    name = lambda sa: f"cluster.local/ns/{NS}/sa/{sa}" if ":" not in sa else sa
    return {name(sa) for sa in required}, {name(sa) for sa in optional}


def permissive_ports(labels):
    ports = set()
    for p in of("PeerAuthentication"):
        if (p["spec"].get("selector") or {}).get("matchLabels") == labels:
            ports |= {str(k) for k, v in (p["spec"].get("portLevelMtls") or {}).items() if (v or {}).get("mode") == "PERMISSIVE"}
    return ports


def section_mirror():
    global ACCOUNTS
    ACCOUNTS = workload_accounts()
    for ap in of("AuthorizationPolicy"):
        check(ap.get("apiVersion") == "security.istio.io/v1", f"AuthorizationPolicy {ap['metadata']['name']} is {ap.get('apiVersion')}")
        check(ap["spec"].get("action", "ALLOW") == "ALLOW", f"AuthorizationPolicy {ap['metadata']['name']} is not ALLOW")
        check(set((ap["spec"].get("selector") or {})) <= {"matchLabels"}, f"AuthorizationPolicy {ap['metadata']['name']} selector is not matchLabels only")
        text = json.dumps(ap["spec"])
        check("notPrincipals" not in text and "requestPrincipals" not in text,
              f"AuthorizationPolicy {ap['metadata']['name']} uses notPrincipals or requestPrincipals")
    want, maybe, unrendered = {}, {}, set()  # json(matchLabels) -> set of (source, port)
    for np in of("NetworkPolicy"):
        rules = np["spec"].get("ingress") or []
        if "Ingress" not in np["spec"].get("policyTypes", []) or not rules:
            continue
        sets = label_sets(np["spec"].get("podSelector"))
        if not sets or sets == [{}]:
            continue
        for labels in sets:
            key = json.dumps(labels, sort_keys=True)
            if not rendered(labels):
                unrendered.add(key)
                continue
            pairs, optional = want.setdefault(key, set()), maybe.setdefault(key, set())
            permissive = permissive_ports(labels)
            for rule in rules:
                ports = {str(p["port"]) for p in rule.get("ports") or [] if p.get("port") != 15008} or {"*"}
                for peer in rule.get("from") or [{}]:
                    if peer == {}:
                        pairs |= {("any", port) for port in ports}
                        continue
                    principals = principals_for(peer)
                    if principals is None:
                        cidr = peer["ipBlock"]["cidr"]
                        if cidr == PROBE_SOURCE or not CLOUD:
                            continue
                        pairs |= {(f"ip:{cidr}", port) for port in ports if port in permissive}
                    else:
                        pairs |= {(pr, port) for pr in principals[0] for port in ports}
                        optional |= {(pr, port) for pr in principals[1] for port in ports}
    got = {}
    for ap in of("AuthorizationPolicy"):
        key = json.dumps((ap["spec"].get("selector") or {}).get("matchLabels") or {}, sort_keys=True)
        pairs = got.setdefault(key, set())
        for rule in ap["spec"].get("rules", []):
            ports = {str(p) for t in rule.get("to", []) for p in (t.get("operation") or {}).get("ports", [])} or {"*"}
            sources = [f.get("source") or {} for f in rule.get("from", [])] or [{}]
            for src in sources:
                if not src:
                    pairs |= {("any", port) for port in ports}
                for pr in src.get("principals", []):
                    pairs |= {(pr, port) for port in ports}
                for cidr in src.get("ipBlocks", []):
                    pairs |= {(f"ip:{cidr}", port) for port in ports}
    for key, pairs in sorted(want.items()):
        have = got.get(key)
        if not pairs and have is None:
            continue
        check(have is not None, f"no AuthorizationPolicy selects {key}")
        if have is not None:
            missing, extra = pairs - have, have - pairs - maybe[key]
            check(not missing and not extra, f"AuthorizationPolicy for {key} differs from its NetworkPolicy ingress: "
                                             f"missing {sorted(missing)}, extra {sorted(extra)}")
    for key in sorted(set(got) - set(want) - unrendered):
        check(False, f"AuthorizationPolicy for {key} has no NetworkPolicy ingress to mirror")
    if not CLOUD:
        check(not any("ipBlocks" in json.dumps(a["spec"]) for a in of("AuthorizationPolicy")),
              f"an AuthorizationPolicy on {OVERLAY} has ipBlocks")


# ---- starrocks-sa: dedicated FE and BE service accounts (§4.2) ----------------------------------------
def section_starrocks_sa():
    s = one("StarRocksCluster", f"{REL}-starrocks")
    if s is None:
        return
    accounts = {d["metadata"]["name"] for d in of("ServiceAccount")}
    for part, key in (("fe", "starRocksFeSpec"), ("be", "starRocksBeSpec")):
        sa = s["spec"].get(key, {}).get("serviceAccount")
        check(sa == f"{REL}-starrocks-{part}", f"{key}.serviceAccount is {sa}")
        check(f"{REL}-starrocks-{part}" in accounts, f"ServiceAccount {REL}-starrocks-{part} does not render")


# ---- fallback: Authorization:OperatorGroupFallback never on Helm (§2.4) -------------------------------
def section_fallback():
    check("OperatorGroupFallback" not in yaml.safe_dump_all(DOCS), "a Helm render sets Authorization:OperatorGroupFallback")


SECTIONS = {
    "vap": section_vap, "kafka": section_kafka, "hbone": section_hbone,
    "gateway-kind": section_gateway_kind, "gateway-gcp": section_gateway_gcp,
    "pdb": lambda: section_pdb(False), "pdb-profile": lambda: section_pdb(True),
    "postgres-self": section_postgres_self, "mirror": section_mirror,
    "starrocks-sa": section_starrocks_sa, "fallback": section_fallback,
}
DEFAULT = ["vap", "kafka", "hbone", "pdb-profile", "postgres-self", "mirror", "starrocks-sa", "fallback"]
DEFAULT += ["gateway-gcp"] if GCP else [] if CLOUD else ["gateway-kind"]
for section in sys.argv[3:] or DEFAULT:
    SECTIONS[section]()
print(f"[{OVERLAY}] {'PASS' if not FAILS else 'FAIL'}", *FAILS, sep="\n  ")
sys.exit(bool(FAILS))
T26CHECK
cat > $SCR/check_t26_opns.py <<'T26OPNSCHECK'
"""CSR round 12 Platform §3.4 and §4.1 render assertions for the operator-namespace policy chart.

python3 check_t26_opns.py <kind|cloud> <apiServerCidrs, comma-separated> < render.yaml

The release is iverson in namespace iverson. Prints "[opns-<profile>] PASS" or "FAIL" with one line
per failed assertion; exits 1 on any failure.
"""
import sys

import yaml

PROFILE, CIDRS = sys.argv[1], set(sys.argv[2].split(","))
KIND = PROFILE == "kind"
REL = REL_NS = "iverson"
DOCS = [d for d in yaml.safe_load_all(sys.stdin) if d]
FAILS = []
NAMESPACES = ["cnpg-system", "kafka", "starrocks", "istio-system"] + (["tigera-operator", "iverson-edge"] if KIND else [])
PROBE_SOURCE = "169.254.7.127/32"


def check(cond, msg):
    if not cond:
        FAILS.append(msg)


def policies(ns):
    return [d for d in DOCS if d.get("kind") == "NetworkPolicy" and d["metadata"].get("namespace") == ns]


def rules(ns, direction):
    for np in policies(ns):
        for rule in np["spec"].get(direction) or []:
            yield np, rule


def ports(rule):
    return {p.get("port") for p in rule.get("ports") or []}


def peers(rule, direction):
    return rule.get("from" if direction == "ingress" else "to") or []


def from_cidrs(cidrs):
    return lambda ps: bool(ps) and all("ipBlock" in p for p in ps) and {p["ipBlock"]["cidr"] for p in ps} == cidrs


def from_anywhere(ps):
    return not ps


def from_pods(ns, labels, own_ns):
    def match(ps):
        for p in ps:
            sel_ns = (p.get("namespaceSelector") or {}).get("matchLabels") or {}
            ns_ok = sel_ns.get("kubernetes.io/metadata.name") == ns or (ns == own_ns and "namespaceSelector" not in p)
            pod = (p.get("podSelector") or {}).get("matchLabels") or {}
            if ns_ok and all(pod.get(k) == v for k, v in labels.items()):
                return True
        return False
    return match


def has(ns, direction, wanted_ports, predicate, what):
    want = set(wanted_ports) | {15008}
    check(any(want <= ports(r) and predicate(peers(r, direction)) for _, r in rules(ns, direction)),
          f"{ns}: no {direction} rule {what} on {sorted(wanted_ports)} + 15008")


for ns in NAMESPACES:
    check(any(np["spec"].get("podSelector") == {} and set(np["spec"].get("policyTypes", [])) == {"Ingress", "Egress"}
              and not np["spec"].get("ingress") and not np["spec"].get("egress") for np in policies(ns)),
          f"{ns}: no default-deny policy")
    check(any(53 in ports(r) for _, r in rules(ns, "egress")), f"{ns}: no DNS egress rule")
    has(ns, "egress", [443, 6443], from_cidrs(CIDRS), "to apiServerCidrs")
    for direction in ("ingress", "egress"):
        for np, rule in rules(ns, direction):
            if ports(rule):
                check(15008 in ports(rule), f"{ns}: {np['metadata']['name']} {direction} rule {sorted(ports(rule), key=str)} lacks 15008")

for ns, port in (("cnpg-system", 9443), ("kafka", 8080), ("starrocks", 8081)):
    has(ns, "ingress", [port], from_cidrs({PROBE_SOURCE}), "from 169.254.7.127/32")
has("cnpg-system", "ingress", [9443], from_cidrs(CIDRS), "from apiServerCidrs")
has("cnpg-system", "egress", [8000, 5432], from_pods(REL_NS, {"cnpg.io/cluster": f"{REL}-postgres"}, "cnpg-system"),
    "to the release's Postgres pods")
has("kafka", "egress", [9090, 9091, 8443], from_pods(REL_NS, {"strimzi.io/cluster": f"{REL}-kafka"}, "kafka"),
    "to the release's Kafka pods")
has("istio-system", "ingress", [15012], from_pods("istio-system", {"app": "ztunnel"}, "istio-system"), "from ztunnel")
has("istio-system", "ingress", [15017], from_cidrs(CIDRS), "from apiServerCidrs")
has("istio-system", "egress", [15012], from_pods("istio-system", {"app": "istiod"}, "istio-system"), "to istiod")
if KIND:
    has("istio-system", "ingress", [15012], from_pods("iverson-edge", {}, "istio-system"), "from the edge gateway")
    has("iverson-edge", "ingress", [80, 443], from_anywhere, "from any source")
    has("iverson-edge", "egress", [8080, 8081], from_pods(REL_NS, {"app": f"{REL}-api"}, "iverson-edge"), "to the api")
    has("iverson-edge", "egress", [8080], from_pods(REL_NS, {"app": f"{REL}-admin-ui"}, "iverson-edge"), "to admin-ui")
    has("iverson-edge", "egress", [9080], from_pods(REL_NS, {"app": f"{REL}-authentik-server"}, "iverson-edge"), "to Authentik")
    has("iverson-edge", "egress", [15012], from_pods("istio-system", {"app": "istiod"}, "iverson-edge"), "to istiod")

pas = [d for d in DOCS if d.get("kind") == "PeerAuthentication" and d["metadata"].get("namespace") == "cnpg-system"]
permissive = {str(k) for p in pas for k, v in (p["spec"].get("portLevelMtls") or {}).items() if (v or {}).get("mode") == "PERMISSIVE"}
if KIND:
    check(not permissive, f"cnpg-system PeerAuthentication has PERMISSIVE ports on kind: {sorted(permissive)}")
else:
    check(any((p["spec"].get("mtls") or {}).get("mode") == "STRICT" for p in pas) and permissive == {"9443"},
          f"cnpg-system PeerAuthentication is not STRICT with only 9443 PERMISSIVE: {sorted(permissive)}")

print(f"[opns-{PROFILE}] {'PASS' if not FAILS else 'FAIL'}", *FAILS, sep="\n  ")
sys.exit(bool(FAILS))

cat > $SCR/check_t26_tf.py <<'T26TFCHECK'
"""CSR round 12 Platform §3.4 Terraform assertions: AKS etcd encryption on a dedicated vault.

python3 check_t26_tf.py <terraform dir> <tfsec output file> <tfsec ignored count on main>

Prints "[terraform] PASS" or "FAIL" with one line per failed assertion; exits 1 on any failure.
"""
import re
import sys

TF, TFSEC, BASE_IGNORED = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], int(sys.argv[3])
FAILS = []


def check(cond, msg):
    if not cond:
        FAILS.append(msg)


def block(text, header):
    """The body of the first block whose opening line matches header, and the comment lines directly above it."""
    m = re.search(r"^" + header + r"\s*\{", text, re.M)
    if not m:
        return None, []
    depth, i = 0, m.end() - 1
    for j in range(i, len(text)):
        depth += {"{": 1, "}": -1}.get(text[j], 0)
        if depth == 0:
            body = text[i + 1:j]
            break
    else:
        return None, []
    above = []
    for line in reversed(text[:m.start()].splitlines()):
        if not line.lstrip().startswith("#"):
            break
        above.append(line.strip())
    return body, above


def ignores(lines):
    return sorted(re.findall(r"#tfsec:ignore:([\w-]+)", "\n".join(lines)))


main = open(f"{TF}/modules/cluster-azure/main.tf").read()
cluster, _ = block(main, r'resource "azurerm_kubernetes_cluster" "this"')
check(cluster is not None, 'resource "azurerm_kubernetes_cluster" "this" not found')
kms, _ = block(cluster or "", r"\s*key_management_service")
check(kms is not None, "the AKS cluster has no key_management_service block")
key_name = re.search(r"key_vault_key_id\s*=\s*azurerm_key_vault_key\.(\w+)\.id", kms or "")
check(key_name is not None, "key_management_service.key_vault_key_id does not name an azurerm_key_vault_key")
check(re.search(r'key_vault_network_access\s*=\s*"Public"', kms or "") is not None,
      'key_management_service.key_vault_network_access is not "Public"')
if key_name:
    key, key_above = block(main, rf'resource "azurerm_key_vault_key" "{key_name.group(1)}"')
    check(key is not None, f"azurerm_key_vault_key.{key_name.group(1)} not found")
    vault_name = re.search(r"key_vault_id\s*=\s*azurerm_key_vault\.(\w+)\.id", key or "")
    check(vault_name is not None and vault_name.group(1) != "data_volumes",
          "the KMS key does not live in a dedicated vault")
    check(ignores(key_above) + ignores([key or ""]) == ["azure-keyvault-ensure-key-expiry"],
          f"the KMS key carries tfsec ignores {ignores(key_above) + ignores([key or ''])}")
    if vault_name:
        v = vault_name.group(1)
        vault, vault_above = block(main, rf'resource "azurerm_key_vault" "{v}"')
        check(vault is not None, f"azurerm_key_vault.{v} not found")
        check(ignores(vault_above) + ignores([vault or ""]) == ["azure-keyvault-specify-network-acl"],
              f"the KMS vault carries tfsec ignores {ignores(vault_above) + ignores([vault or ''])}")
        check(re.search(r"purge_protection_enabled\s*=\s*true", vault or "") is not None,
              "the KMS vault does not keep purge protection")
        grants = [b for b in re.split(r'^resource "azurerm_key_vault_access_policy"', main, flags=re.M)[1:]
                  if re.search(rf"key_vault_id\s*=\s*azurerm_key_vault\.{v}\.id", b.split("\nresource ")[0])]
        check(any("azurerm_user_assigned_identity.control_plane.principal_id" in g.split("\nresource ")[0]
                  and "Encrypt" in g.split("\nresource ")[0] and "Decrypt" in g.split("\nresource ")[0] for g in grants),
              "no access policy gives the control-plane identity Encrypt and Decrypt on the KMS vault")

counts = dict(re.findall(r"^\s+(passed|ignored|critical|high|medium|low)\s+(\d+)\s*$", open(TFSEC).read(), re.M))
for level in ("critical", "high", "medium", "low"):
    check(counts.get(level) == "0", f"tfsec {level}: {counts.get(level)}")
check(counts.get("ignored") == str(BASE_IGNORED + 2), f"tfsec ignored {counts.get('ignored')}, main {BASE_IGNORED}: not exactly two more")

print(f"[terraform] {'PASS' if not FAILS else 'FAIL'}", *FAILS, sep="\n  ")
sys.exit(bool(FAILS))
T26TFCHECK
cat > $SCR/t26_mut.py <<'T26MUTPY'
"""Applies one named mutation to a render and writes the result: python3 t26_mut.py <id> < render.yaml > mutated.yaml"""
import sys
import yaml

MID = sys.argv[1]
docs = [d for d in yaml.safe_load_all(sys.stdin) if d]


def first(kind, test=lambda d: True):
    return next(d for d in docs if d["kind"] == kind and test(d))


def labels_are(labels):
    return lambda d: ((d["spec"].get("selector") or {}).get("matchLabels") or {}) == labels


if MID == "M1":    # 15008 leaves the first NetworkPolicy rule that lists it
    rule = next(r for d in docs if d["kind"] == "NetworkPolicy" for k in ("ingress", "egress")
                for r in d["spec"].get(k) or [] if any(p.get("port") == 15008 for p in r.get("ports") or []))
    rule["ports"] = [p for p in rule["ports"] if p.get("port") != 15008]
elif MID == "M2":  # the binding only warns
    first("ValidatingAdmissionPolicyBinding")["spec"]["validationActions"] = ["Warn"]
elif MID == "M3":  # the job controller is no longer admitted
    i = docs.index(first("ValidatingAdmissionPolicy"))
    docs[i] = yaml.safe_load(yaml.safe_dump(docs[i]).replace("kube-system:job-controller", "kube-system:jobs-controller"))
elif MID == "M4":  # the Kafka tls listener loses its peers
    next(l for l in first("Kafka")["spec"]["kafka"]["listeners"] if l["name"] == "tls").pop("networkPolicyPeers")
elif MID == "M5":  # the Postgres instances' own principal leaves its AuthorizationPolicy
    ap = first("AuthorizationPolicy", labels_are({"cnpg.io/cluster": "iverson-postgres"}))
    for rule in ap["spec"]["rules"]:
        for f in rule.get("from", []):
            src = f.get("source") or {}
            src["principals"] = [p for p in src.get("principals", []) if not p.endswith("/sa/iverson-postgres")]
elif MID == "M6":  # an ipBlocks rule on a kind profile
    first("AuthorizationPolicy", labels_are({"app": "iverson-api"}))["spec"]["rules"].append(
        {"from": [{"source": {"ipBlocks": ["172.18.0.0/16"]}}], "to": [{"operation": {"ports": ["8080"]}}]})
elif MID == "M7":  # the gRPC route goes
    docs.remove(first("GRPCRoute"))
elif MID == "M8":  # the GKE Gateway gains a port-80 listener
    first("Gateway")["spec"]["listeners"].append({"name": "http", "port": 80, "protocol": "HTTP"})
elif MID == "M9":  # the Authentik server PDB goes
    docs.remove(first("PodDisruptionBudget", labels_are({"app": "iverson-authentik-server"})))
elif MID == "M10":  # the compose-only group fallback reaches a Helm render
    first("Deployment", lambda d: d["metadata"]["name"] == "iverson-api")["spec"]["template"]["spec"]["containers"][0]["env"].append(
        {"name": "Authorization__OperatorGroupFallback", "value": "operators"})
elif MID == "M11":  # Cloud Armor leaves the Authentik backend
    spec = first("GCPBackendPolicy")["spec"]
    (spec.get("default") or spec).pop("securityPolicy")
elif MID == "M12":  # the StarRocks FE runs as default again
    first("StarRocksCluster")["spec"]["starRocksFeSpec"]["serviceAccount"] = "default"
elif MID == "M13":  # one AuthorizationPolicy port drifts from its NetworkPolicy
    rule = next(r for d in docs if d["kind"] == "AuthorizationPolicy" for r in d["spec"].get("rules", []) if r.get("to"))
    ports = rule["to"][0]["operation"]["ports"]
    ports[0] = str(int(ports[0]) + 1)
elif MID == "M14":  # the kafka namespace loses its default-deny
    docs.remove(first("NetworkPolicy", lambda d: d["metadata"].get("namespace") == "kafka" and d["spec"].get("podSelector") == {}
                       and not d["spec"].get("ingress") and not d["spec"].get("egress")))
elif MID == "M15":  # the VAP stops matching ephemeral containers
    for rule in first("ValidatingAdmissionPolicy")["spec"]["matchConstraints"]["resourceRules"]:
        rule["resources"] = [r for r in rule.get("resources", []) if r != "pods/ephemeralcontainers"]
else:
    sys.exit(f"unknown mutation {MID}")
yaml.safe_dump_all(docs, sys.stdout, sort_keys=False)
T26MUTPY
```

```bash
            Payload = new Struct { Fields = { ["Title"] = Value.ForString(args[2]) } } }, acting);

        {

        using (var call = search.Search(new SearchRequest { TypeName = "Csr12pNote", PageSize = 50 }, acting))
            await foreach (var r in call.ResponseStream.ReadAllAsync())
                titles.Add(r.Data.Fields["Title"].StringValue);
        Console.WriteLine($"search rows={titles.Count} titles={string.Join(",", titles.Order())}"); break;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: The full conformance harness over TLS** against the isolated stack, every scenario and every language. Each runtime trusts the compose CA through its standard setting (VA75): `SSL_CERT_FILE` (.NET, Go, Python urllib), `GRPC_DEFAULT_SSL_ROOTS_FILE_PATH` (grpcio), `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` (Node) and a PKCS12 trust store through `JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS` (Java). The bundle and trust store also hold the public roots, because the drivers' builds fetch packages.

```bash
# Polls Authentik's database every 5 s, from before the release exists until every custom/ blueprint instance
# has read successful for 12 polls in a row, or 40 minutes. One JSON line per poll in $LIVE/converge.log.
source /tmp/claude-1000/-home-ben-repositories-Iverson/a8dc481d-50d9-445a-974d-18c6594e3306/scratchpad/csr12p-sdd/env.sh
OUT=$LIVE/converge.log; : > $OUT
PSQL="kubectl $OPS_AS -n iverson exec iverson-postgres-1 -c postgres -- psql -d authentik -tA -c"
VT=""
streak=0
for i in $(seq 1 480); do
  now=$(date -u +%FT%TZ)
  if [ -z "$VT" ]; then
    VT=$($PSQL "SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND column_name = 'not_configured_action' AND table_name LIKE 'authentik_stages_authenticator_validate%'" 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
  fi

    echo "{\"t\": \"$now\", \"state\": \"not migrated\"}" >> $OUT
    sleep 5; continue
  fi
  row=$($PSQL "SELECT json_build_object(
    't', '$now',
    'instances', (SELECT json_object_agg(name, status) FROM authentik_blueprints_blueprintinstance),
    'paths', (SELECT json_object_agg(path, status) FROM authentik_blueprints_blueprintinstance WHERE path LIKE 'custom/%'),
    'api_app', (SELECT count(*) FROM authentik_core_application WHERE slug = 'iverson-api'),
    'api_gate', (SELECT count(*) FROM authentik_core_application a
                   JOIN authentik_policies_policybinding b ON b.target_id = a.policybindingmodel_ptr_id AND b.enabled
                   JOIN authentik_policies_expression_expressionpolicy e ON e.policy_ptr_id = b.policy_id
                 WHERE a.slug = 'iverson-api' AND e.expression LIKE '%tenant-admins%'),
    'setup_flow', (SELECT count(*) FROM authentik_flows_flow WHERE slug = 'initial-setup'),
    'setup_mode', (SELECT m.policy_engine_mode FROM authentik_flows_flow f
                     JOIN authentik_policies_policybindingmodel m ON m.pbm_uuid = f.policybindingmodel_ptr_id
                   WHERE f.slug = 'initial-setup'),
    'setup_deny', (SELECT count(*) FROM authentik_flows_flow f
                     JOIN authentik_policies_policybinding b ON b.target_id = f.policybindingmodel_ptr_id AND b.enabled
                     JOIN authentik_policies_expression_expressionpolicy e ON e.policy_ptr_id = b.policy_id
                   WHERE f.slug = 'initial-setup' AND e.expression ~ 'return\s+False'),
    'mfa', (SELECT v.not_configured_action FROM $VT v JOIN authentik_flows_stage s ON s.stage_uuid = v.stage_ptr_id
            WHERE s.name = 'default-authentication-mfa-validation'),
    'login_flow', (SELECT count(*) FROM authentik_flows_flow WHERE slug = 'default-authentication-flow'),
    'login_throttle', (SELECT count(*) FROM authentik_flows_flowstagebinding x
                         JOIN authentik_flows_flow f ON f.flow_uuid = x.target_id
                         JOIN authentik_flows_stage s ON s.stage_uuid = x.stage_id
                       WHERE f.slug = 'default-authentication-flow' AND s.name = 'iverson-login-throttled'),
    'recovery_flow', (SELECT count(*) FROM authentik_flows_flow WHERE slug = 'iverson-recovery'),
    'recovery_throttle', (SELECT count(*) FROM authentik_flows_flowstagebinding x
                            JOIN authentik_flows_flow f ON f.flow_uuid = x.target_id
                            JOIN authentik_flows_stage s ON s.stage_uuid = x.stage_id
                          WHERE f.slug = 'iverson-recovery' AND s.name = 'iverson-login-throttled'))" 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -z "$row" ]; then
    echo "{\"t\": \"$now\", \"state\": \"query failed\"}" >> $OUT
  else
    echo "$row" >> $OUT
    if echo "$row" | python3 -c 'import json, sys; d = json.load(sys.stdin)["paths"] or {}; sys.exit(not d or any(v != "successful" for v in d.values()))'; then
      streak=$((streak + 1))
    else
      streak=0
    fi
    [ $streak -ge 12 ] && break
  fi
  sleep 5
done
echo "POLL-DONE after $i polls" >> $OUT
T27POLL
cat > $LIVE/converge-report.py <<'T27REPORT'
"""Reads $LIVE/converge.log and reports each §6 fresh-install window and the last blueprint statuses.
python3 converge-report.py <converge.log>"""

polls = []

for name, is_open in WINDOWS.items():
    hits = [d["t"] for d in polls if is_open(d)]
    print(f"{name}: " + (f"open in {len(hits)} polls, first {hits[0]}, last {hits[-1]}" if hits else "never"))
last = polls[-1]["instances"] if polls else {}
bad = {k: v for k, v in (last or {}).items() if v != "successful"}
print(f"last poll: {len(last or {})} blueprint instances, not successful: {bad or 'none'}")
print(f"final values: mfa={polls[-1]['mfa'] if polls else '-'} setup_mode={polls[-1]['setup_mode'] if polls else '-'}")
T27REPORT
```

```bash
source /tmp/claude-1000/-home-ben-repositories-Iverson/a8dc481d-50d9-445a-974d-18c6594e3306/scratchpad/csr12p-sdd/env.sh
cat > $LIVE/migration-wait.py <<'T27WAIT'
# Usage: kubectl get pods -n iverson -o json | python3 migration-wait.py <label>. Compares the worker's migrate init
# container with each server pod's wait init container (its init containers other than native sidecars).
import json, sys
pods = json.load(sys.stdin)["items"]
def inits(p):
    sidecars = {c["name"] for c in p["spec"].get("initContainers", []) if c.get("restartPolicy") == "Always"}
    return [s for s in p["status"].get("initContainerStatuses", []) if s["name"] not in sidecars]
app = lambda p: p["metadata"].get("labels", {}).get("app")
workers = [s for p in pods if app(p) == "iverson-authentik-worker" for s in inits(p) if s["name"] == "migrate"]
servers = [(p["metadata"]["name"], s) for p in pods if app(p) == "iverson-authentik-server" for s in inits(p)]
assert len(workers) == 1, f"{len(workers)} worker migrate containers"
term = lambda s: (s.get("state", {}).get("terminated") or s.get("lastState", {}).get("terminated") or {})
w = term(workers[0])
print(f"{sys.argv[1]} worker migrate: started {w.get('startedAt')}, finished {w.get('finishedAt')}, exit {w.get('exitCode')}")
for name, s in servers:
    t = term(s)
    waited = t.get("startedAt", "") < w.get("finishedAt", "") <= t.get("finishedAt", "")
    print(f"{sys.argv[1]} {name} {s['name']}: started {t.get('startedAt')}, finished {t.get('finishedAt')}, exit {t.get('exitCode')}, waited for the migration: {'yes' if waited else 'no'}")
T27WAIT
kubectl get pods -n iverson -o json | python3 $LIVE/migration-wait.py fresh
```
